method: Inspected the original 4x4 RGBA atlas, transparent crop contact sheet, and all 16 actual composited sticker previews on light and dark neutral backgrounds at normal display size. Checked cell identity, crop boundaries, alpha edges, silhouette/readability at sticker scale, and uniqueness; subtle dust and scratch assets were judged at their intended low opacity.
observation: 数条细长纵向划痕与少量污点形成胶片磨损感，和浮尘贴图辨识度不同。
